name: gravityforms
label: Gravity Forms
description: Build and publish your WordPress forms

siteUrl.label: Site URL
siteUrl.description: Your WordPress site address, e.g. https://example.com. The host only, without https://, such as name.example.com.

gravityforms_get_form.label: Get Form
gravityforms_get_form.description: Gets a form with its fields, notifications and confirmations.

formId.label: Form ID
formId.description: Numeric form id, e.g. "14". Use List Forms to find it.

gravityforms_list_entries.label: List Entries
gravityforms_list_entries.description: Searches form entries with filters, sorting and paging.

formId.label: Form ID
formId.description: Only return entries of this form, e.g. "14". Use List Forms to find it. Defaults to all forms.

status.label: Entry Status
status.description: Which entries to include: "active", "spam" or "trash". Defaults to "active".

fieldFilters.label: Field Filters
fieldFilters.description: Array of filters, e.g. [{"key":"1","value":"Jane","operator":"contains"}]. key is a field id, entry property (e.g. "date_created", "is_starred") or meta key; operator is one of =, is, isnot, <>, contains, like, in, notin and defaults to "=". Use List Field Filters to see valid keys. Defaults to no filter.

filterMode.label: Filter Mode
filterMode.description: "all" matches entries that pass every filter, "any" entries that pass at least one. Defaults to "all".

sortKey.label: Sort By
sortKey.description: Field id or entry property to sort by, e.g. "date_created" or "3". Defaults to "id".

page.label: Page
page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Defaults to 1.

gravityforms_get_entry.label: Get Entry
gravityforms_get_entry.description: Gets one entry with its field values.

entryId.label: Entry ID
entryId.description: Numeric entry id, e.g. "159". Use List Entries to find it.

gravityforms_get_feed.label: Get Feed
gravityforms_get_feed.description: Gets one add-on feed with its settings.

feedId.label: Feed ID
feedId.description: Numeric add-on feed id, e.g. "3". Use List Feeds to find it.

gravityforms_update_feed.label: Update Feed
gravityforms_update_feed.description: Changes some of an add-on feed's settings, or turns it on or off.

feedId.label: Feed ID
feedId.description: Numeric add-on feed id, e.g. "3". Use List Feeds to find it.

meta.label: Meta
meta.description: Feed settings to change, e.g. {"feedName":"Send to CRM v2"}. Keys not sent keep their value. Defaults to none.

isActive.label: Active
isActive.description: "true" turns the feed on, "false" turns it off. Defaults to unchanged.

feedOrder.label: Order
feedOrder.description: Position of the feed among the form's feeds of the same add-on, starting at 0. Defaults to unchanged.

feedId.label: Feed ID
feedId.description: Numeric add-on feed id, e.g. "3". Use List Feeds to find it.

gravityforms_get_form_results.label: Get Form Results
gravityforms_get_form_results.description: Gets aggregated Quiz, Poll or Survey results for a form.

formId.label: Form ID
formId.description: Numeric form id, e.g. "14". Use List Forms to find it.

status.label: Entry Status
status.description: Which entries to include: "active", "spam" or "trash". Defaults to "active".

fieldFilters.label: Field Filters
fieldFilters.description: Array of filters, e.g. [{"key":"1","value":"Jane","operator":"contains"}]. key is a field id, entry property (e.g. "date_created", "is_starred") or meta key; operator is one of =, is, isnot, <>, contains, like, in, notin and defaults to "=". Use List Field Filters to see valid keys. Defaults to no filter.

filterMode.label: Filter Mode
filterMode.description: "all" matches entries that pass every filter, "any" entries that pass at least one. Defaults to "all".
